description: This PHP class 'OpenvasOutputProcessor' processes XML output files from OpenVAS vulnerability scans, parsing vulnerabilities and associated assets, and converting them into a structured 'ProcessorResult' for further use.

classes.name: OpenvasOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that extends 'AbstractOutputProcessor' to process OpenVAS XML scan reports, extract vulnerabilities, and assets.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Parses an XML report file at the given path, extracts vulnerabilities and related assets, and returns a 'ProcessorResult' object containing the processed vulnerabilities.
